# FDG3008

> DO choose easily readable identifier names.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 3.2.1 Word Choice.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

## From the book

For example, a property named `HorizontalAlignment` is more English-readable than `AlignmentHorizontal`.
